svg.title: Three invented journeys, two identical photographs
svg.desc: Time runs left to right from 10 to 12. Position along an invented corridor runs vertically. All journeys start at kilometre zero and end at kilometre four. At 11 their positions are minus two, two and six kilometres. Every leg respects a six kilometre per hour speed cap.

g.text: Two fixes do not select a journey
Invented corridor · distance in km · maximum speed 6 km/h
Dots: assumed photo fixes. Lines: possible stories, not observed tracks.
